changes: Affiliate Shop Import JSON now accepts AZOBSS generic JSON, Shopee Buy Now mapping JSON, and full Product Offer exporter output.
Repeated import updates an existing product instead of intentionally adding another product for the same Shop ID + Item ID.
Shopee Buy Now requires a recognized affiliate link (s.shopee.com.my, shope.ee, or /an_redir); rows without a valid affiliate link are skipped.
Retail product URL is kept separately as originLink/reference.
Stable Shopee identity fields are saved so Firestore reloads can dedupe future imports.
Existing v1324 Software Tools performance and v1325 Affiliate bulk select/pin are preserved.
